messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.31-0 released
messages.body_plain:
A new version of the NMOF package is available from 
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm


NEWS file entry:

v0.31-0  (2013-12-27)

  o new function 'callMerton' for European calls under Merton's
    jump--diffusion model

  o new vignette "Overview of the NMOF package"

  o smaller changes/updates in documentation


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
